trial_court: Family Court No.1, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur (case No.842/2020)
case_name: Smt. Lataa Nawani W/O Himanshu Nanwani, ... vs Himanshu Nawani S/O Ashok Nanwani

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Lataa Nawani W/o Himanshu Nanwani, wife
parties.respondent_defendant: Himanshu Nawani S/o Ashok Nanwani, husband

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 10.02.2012 at Jodhpur. Petitioner is a poor lady having no source of income; she is unable to maintain herself and cannot bear the litigation expenses.

legal_principles.principle: A transfer of a case from one court to another is allowed when the petitioner faces great hardship in attending the proceedings at the original court.
legal_principles.held: Apart from this, petitioner is under reasonable apprehension of mishappening with her at Jaipur, as respondent has given threatening to petitioner so many times.

legal_principles.principle: A court may consider the distance between two places and the hardship caused to a party in deciding whether to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: The distance between Jaipur and Jodhpur is about 350 Km.

outcome.final_order: The case pending before the Family Court, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur No.1 was transferred to Family Court, Jodhpur City, District Jodhpur.

use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of cases between courts
